  "about_us" text,
  "address" text,
  "city" text,
  "company_name" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "country" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "representative_email" text,
  "representative_name" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "representative_phone" text,
  "representative_title" text,
  "services" text,
  "social_links" json,
  "tagline" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updated_by" text,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
